climate.detail: green typology in temperate climate zone

energy.status_message: It was not confirmed that nearby building cooling demand is relevant to this intervention.

recommendation: This site shows a moderate heat priority. The assessed intervention represents a moderate NbS cooling opportunity. Strategic individual-tree planting is expected to deliver an indicative daytime air temperature reduction of 0.5-2.88 C at pedestrian level, principally through shade, then evapotranspiration once established. Cooling-energy savings were not calculated (it was not confirmed that nearby building cooling demand is relevant to this intervention). Capital cost, payback and cost feasibility were not estimated because no cost input was supplied. This tool ships no default cost values. Data completeness for this assessment is low; treat the result as a screening signal for further investigation rather than a conclusion.
method_note: Results are screening-level estimates based on simplified typology factors and user-provided assumptions. They are not microclimate simulation outputs. Detailed design, local climate analysis and maintenance planning are required before implementation. All cooling estimates are daytime values; nighttime effects are substantially smaller and are not estimated by this tool.
